interpretation: Trade-off, not an improvement: EVAL500 improved slightly (0.0377->0.0357) but the 7-person names CER collapsed 0.8894->1.1339 within the first 125 steps and never recovered. The run's own combinedCER best-checkpoint selector picked step125 despite the names collapse, i.e. the selection metric is not aligned with the names objective. v15 best@500 remains the best names checkpoint (0.8894); v17 step125 is the best EVAL500 checkpoint (0.0357).
claim_boundary: achieved-on-cleaner-data scores, no causation proof; best step selected by the run's combinedCER on dev evals; EVAL500 separate from names; init was v15 best@500.
